issue.title: test_config_center_logs_tab_png_snapshot fails under full parallel just test-visual, passes in isolation
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-w0.5 ("Documentation, new snapshot scenarios, and bench
baselines", epic sase-w0, plan 202609/unified_updates_tab_1.md) as a PROPOSED
FOLLOW-UP, routed to a task by sase-w0.land on 2026-09-04.

During epic sase-w0's final verification sweep on tree 719275bc8,
`test_config_center_logs_tab_png_snapshot` failed with a large pixel diff when the
full `just test-visual` suite ran under parallel xdist workers, and passed 3/3 in
isolation on the same unchanged tree. Neither this test nor the Config Center Logs
pane was touched by epic sase-w0 (the plugins_browser/Updates merge), so the epic is
not the cause. The Justfile's bench-visual-convergence-flakes recipe comment already
documents a known history of visual-suite convergence flakiness under worker
contention.

Triage should identify which async content of the Logs tab is still converging when
`wait_for_visual_idle` accepts the frame under CPU contention, and add an explicit
semantic wait — the same remedy shape as sase-vo / sase-uy for the commits-pane
siblings. sase-ct (the retired ACE-TUI parallel-flake umbrella) covers the class but
no longer accepts corroboration, so this is the node-specific bead.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed with a large pixel diff under the full parallel just test-visual xdist run on clean tree 719275bc8 (2026-09-04); passed 3/3 in isolation on the same tree. Fails only under worker contention; not reproduced serially.
